steps.title: Define SoundScape Studio architecture
steps.description: Establish the project layout and core requirements for real-time stereophonic sound synthesis using only pure Java Android SDK APIs.

steps.title: Configure Build Tools & Gradle
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper compilation options, setting targetSdkVersion to 34, AGP to 8.3.2, and enabling Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Create Native Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml file, ensuring correct namespace definition, defining application permissions, orientation settings, and launcher metadata.

steps.title: Establish Dark Synth Colors
steps.description: Create standard Android XML resources for colors, setting a highly-immersive futuristic Dark Synth style palette.

steps.title: Develop Premium UI Backgrounds
steps.description: Build custom state drawables for buttons, active gradients, and card backgrounds to deliver a responsive, physical feel to standard layouts.

steps.title: Design SoundWaveVisualizer View
steps.description: Create a custom Android View component designed to render interactive dual-channel waveforms utilizing custom Paint, Canvas, and animation triggers.

steps.title: Design Premium Studio Layout
steps.description: Assemble activity_main.xml layout inside a ScrollView, laying out preset selection buttons, precise SeekBars for carrier/beat tuners, mixing control panels, and sleep timer.

steps.title: Implement Continuous Audio Synthesizer
steps.description: Write high-fidelity math formulas inside SoundScape Studio synthesis loop using phase accumulation to enable smooth frequency sweeps.

steps.title: Implement Rain and Ocean FX Modulators
steps.description: Embed noise filters and low-frequency oscillation math models to simulate rain patters and wave sweeps without audio files.

steps.title: Create Preset Configuration System
steps.description: Program pre-defined brainwave settings (Focus, Deep Meditation, Deep Sleep, High Alert, Schumann Resonance) and wire them to quick-selection triggers.

steps.title: Develop Automatic Sleep Timer with Fade-out
steps.description: Write background countdown task using handler callbacks to slowly adjust master sound gain down over the final 15 seconds before auto-shutoff.

steps.title: Incorporate Educational Dialog
steps.description: Provide a clean native dialog explaining Binaural physics, brainwave levels (Alpha, Beta, Delta, Gamma, Theta), and mandatory stereo headwear guidelines.

steps.title: Review Java 8 and Thread Safety
steps.description: Validate that there are no lambda functions, stream APIs, or unsafe variable access between the rendering main UI and the audio production thread.

steps.title: Building SoundScape Studio
steps.description: Compile raw source files, layouts, and resource scripts into a fully debuggable APK.
